basic.name: Queen's Curse
basic.description: After a short delay, turn enemy Heroes in an area into plant zombies for 3 seconds, making them unable to attack, use Abilities, and slowing them by 30%.

basic.name: Overgrowth
basic.description: Spawn an Overgrowth that disables nearby Structures.  You deal 100% bonus damage to Structures affected by Overgrowth.  Slowly loses Health over 25 seconds.

basic.name: Sprint
basic.description: Increase Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds.

basic.name: Charge
basic.description:
Charge a target and deal 225 damage in an area. 

Non-Heroes take 200% increased damage.

basic.name: Rocket Fist
basic.description:
Launch a Rocket Fist that deals 200 damage to the first Hero or Structure in its path. The rocket pushes away and Stuns Heroes for 1.5 seconds and disables Structures for 4 seconds.

Instantly kills Minions in its path.

basic.name: Shield Emitter
basic.description: Gain 25 Armor and Shield nearby allied Heroes for 450. Lasts 3 seconds.

basic.name: Particle Cannon
basic.description: Fire the Particle Cannon, dealing 225 damage in an area.

basic.name: Particle Cannon
basic.description: Start extending the range of the Particle Cannon. Reactivate to fire, dealing 225 damage in the target area.

basic.name: Gatling Cannon
basic.description:
Toggle to fire missiles at the cursor's location. Each missile deals 45 damage but drains 1 Energy. Reactivate to stop firing.

Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

basic.name: Scorching Laser
basic.description:
Vector Targeting
Draw a line on the ground, dealing 75 damage. After 1 second, it explodes for 500 damage.

WitchDoctorGargantuan.name: Gargantuan
WitchDoctorGargantuan.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100~~0.04~~ damage when summoned, attacks for 140~~0.04~~ damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240~~0.04~~ damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

WitchDoctorZombieWallDeadRushTalentUnit.name: Zombie Wall
WitchDoctorZombieWallDeadRushTalentUnit.description: A MINDLESS ZOMBIE LOG FROM HELL

WizardMinion.name: Leader Minion
WizardMinion.description: Attacks at short range. Drops a Regen Globe when destroyed

XalatathDarkHeartRitual.name: Dark Heart Ritual (Unit)
XalatathDarkHeartRitual.description:
Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 50~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.

The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.

The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonate on impact, dealing 245~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and 61~~0.04~~ more damage to the Marked target.

YrelSacredGround.name: Sacred Ground
YrelSacredGround.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

ZagaraCreepTumor.name: Creep Tumor
ZagaraCreepTumor.description:
Lay a Creep Tumor that generates Creep. While on Creep, Zagara moves 20% faster and her summons move 30% faster. Tumors lose Health over 250 seconds and reveal the surrounding area while active.

Stores up to 3 charges.

ZagaraDevouringMaw.name: Devouring Maw
ZagaraDevouringMaw.description:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94~~0.04~~ damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.
